about.title: About
about.currently: Combining my diploma in Byzantine music with code: I'm building a classifier that recognises, from audio, which musical mode (echos) a hymn is in (Python, librosa, React). Alongside that, I'm exploring EEG signal processing and Brain-Computer Interfaces.
about.p1: I'm a full-stack engineer with 7+ years building web and mobile applications, from database to UI. For nearly 4 years I was responsible for two nationwide production systems in Greece: the Hellenic Coast Guard's incident-tracking system, used by every Port Authority in the country, and Safe Water Sports, a water-safety app for iOS and Android with 50,000 users. I fixed database issues, improved their reliability and built new features. Most recently I built frontend modules for SOLON, Lithuania's national tax portal. I work well both when I own a system end-to-end and inside a larger team. Open to roles in Greece, remote, or relocation.
